figurative_meaning_en: a little, a small amount, scant quantity
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুমুঠো ভাত খেয়ে সন্তুষ্ট হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He has just a handful of money.
She was satisfied with a small portion of rice.
history: Refers to traditional hand-measuring of grains like rice in rural Bengali households, symbolizing minimal sustenance.
note: Often used in contexts of poverty or simplicity in daily life.
